groups.title: Needed to start
groups.say: Do these and the engine can do real work for you.

groups.title: When you want it
groups.say: Each of these is off until you choose it. Each line says what it opens up and what it costs or sends off this Mac.

groups.title: Not possible yet
groups.say: These cannot be set up yet. Nothing can be published or sent from here until they exist.

steps.title: Models
steps.line: Plans mode is on, but the Claude agents have no login of their own yet.
steps.why: Your agents think with these. Plans mode uses your Claude and Codex plans; Omega Plus is a paid service you can switch on in Settings instead.

commands.lead: Only you can do this. Open Terminal and run:

steps.title: The fence check
steps.line: The fence held at its last check.
steps.why: The fence is what keeps agents away from the internet, your files and your logins. The proof checks that it holds.

steps.title: Company basics
steps.why: Every agent reads these before it works, so what it makes sounds like your company. Filling them takes about 20 minutes.
notes: Still to fill: What we never say, What we sell, Terms, Refunds, Our support promise, Team and Ideal customer.

steps.title: Brand kit
steps.why: Your colours, fonts and logo. Posters, pages and apps are made in this look.

steps.title: The books
steps.line: The books are connected. Your company's details are not in them yet.
steps.why: Invoices, customers, support and leave are kept in the books.
notes: Until then invoices say "Nil-Rated" even where tax is charged, and leave can be drafted but not made final.

commands.lead: Only you can do this. Open Terminal and run:

steps.title: A first real task
steps.why: Say what you want done in your own words. The Chief of staff hands it out, and the Checker looks at the result before it reaches you.

steps.title: The Checker's own login
steps.line: The Checker has no Codex login yet.
steps.opens: The Checker stops depending on your own login, and the proof's note about it goes away.

commands.lead: Only you can do this. Open Terminal and run:

steps.title: Routines
steps.opens: Standing work on a schedule, such as a daily brief each morning and a weekly content plan.
costs: Each run costs one run of that agent on your plan.

steps.title: The web for the Researcher
steps.line: Off. No agent can reach the internet.
steps.opens: The Researcher can read public pages, search and watch public videos, and the jobs that need the web can start.
costs: When this is on, the addresses the Researcher opens and the words it searches for leave this Mac.

steps.title: The page viewer
steps.line: Off. A page job stops until it is switched on.
steps.opens: The Builder and the Art director can open the pages they build and take pictures, and you see those pictures on the task.
costs: Chrome has to be installed on this Mac. The viewer never touches your own Chrome or its profile.

steps.title: Runway: clips and pictures
steps.opens: The Artist can turn your renders into short clips, make variations of a picture and make a picture larger.
costs: This costs money beyond your plans. Nothing is spent until you approve a cost.
notes: Most to spend in a day: $3.00. Most to spend in a month: $10.00. A limit of 0 stops all making.

steps.title: Higgsfield
steps.line: Not signed in. Higgsfield is off.
steps.opens: A few models for pictures and clips that Runway does not have.
costs: It spends inside the same daily and monthly limits as Runway.

steps.title: App Studio
steps.opens: The apps your company made, opened inside the home screen.
costs: An app cannot spend anything until you say so.

steps.title: The brain
steps.line: Off. The setup could not ask the books whether Track changes is on for Project and Contact.
steps.opens: Agents find the right passage in your files and records instead of reading every file whole.

notYet.title: Publishing posts
notYet.line: Approved posts and newsletters stay here. Nothing is posted.
notYet.how: Connect an account to turn this on.
